entities.name: Quopomma
entities.description: Ogre soldier of the Dark Age, one of Maeveen O'Donagh's two lieutenants, strong and loyal.

entities.name: Vervamon
entities.description: Scholar under whom Maeveen served, little respected by Quopomma.

events.summary: Maeveen saw Quopomma knock out every member of a tavern brawl and then return to her beer.
events.quote: knock out every single member of a tavern brawl

relations.note: One of her two lieutenants, loyal to her.
relations.quote: Quopomma was one of Maeveen O'Donagh 's two lieutenants
